originalAlarm.description: Assigned value is garbage or undefined

sanitizedDescription: Assigned value is garbage or undefined
reasoning: TRUE POSITIVE (CORRECTLY CONSTRAINED): c708c57e247.c (Linux S390 PRNG). 'Assigned value is garbage or undefined' at line 18 ('*((__u64 *)parm_block) ^= *((__u64 *)buf+i*8)'). This is the known vbdb bug (// ERROR at line 18): incorrect pointer arithmetic. The expression '(__u64 *)buf+i*8' adds i*8 in units of sizeof(__u64)=8 bytes, so the byte offset is i*8*8 = i*64. On the second loop iteration (i=8 after 'i += 8'), this accesses buf[64] which is far out of bounds of buf[16], reading garbage memory. The correct code should be '(__u64 *)(buf+i*8)' (cast after byte-offset arithmetic) to add i*8 bytes. When called with nbytes=16 (line 28), the loop runs twice: first iteration (i=0) is valid, second iteration (i=8) reads garbage from out-of-bounds memory. CORRECTLY CONSTRAINED: CONFIG_S390_PRNG=true is required since prng_seed() and parm_block are only compiled under '#ifdef CONFIG_S390_PRNG'.
